function g<T extends unknown[]>(...a: [...T, number]): T { return a.slice(0, -1) as T; }
const xs: string[] = ["a"];
const r: string[] = g(...xs, 1);
console.log(r);
function h<T extends unknown[]>(...a: [...T, number]): number { return a.length; }
console.log(h(...xs, 1), h("x", ...xs, 1));
const t: [boolean, string] = [true, "s"];
const u: [boolean, string] = g(...t, 2);
console.log(u);
const bad: string[] = g(...xs, "z");
